3 layers, no LayerNorm. L1: 6 shift heads give a 7-char window; MLP lexicon-stem neurons -> SCORE, negator neurons -> NEGF. L2: gated attention finds a negator within ~14 chars, MLP flips SCORE. L3: uniform average -> sign readout.
